scope: Original P0/I1/I2/I3/I4 and all 27 requirements retained. Production PackageStore/InstalledPluginRegistry/collection process-death and recovery proof on local macOS arm64 only.
methodology: The parent creates immutable baseline/history packages using production APIs and runs a native helper linked to the production packages library. No production test hooks were added.
Copy interruption parks inside the existing copy-progress callback with a payload strictly between 0 and 4MiB; later markers occur after actual package publication or completed index transactions.
The parent verifies PID plus native creation time is Alive, force-terminates the same QProcess, waits for terminal CrashExit and confirms the native identity is Exited.

A fresh native process loads the durable index, verifies current/previous/pendingPrevious package integrity and reports recovered state. A second process must produce the same state and leave disk unchanged.

Collection then runs from the durable references. A third fresh verifier independently checks all retained versions after collection, so a shared reference-scanner omission cannot masquerade as success.

Enabled and disabled histories are both tested; deferred update keeps three versions and pending validation recovers original current/history/source. A live recovery index lock causes failure without rewriting the index or removing the live lock.
Throwing plugin entries would create an execution marker if imported; no marker is created. Processes operate only on isolated temporary directories.
knownLimits: Checkpoint process termination does not simulate power loss, disk-full/fsync hardware faults or termination inside QSaveFile rename/fsync.
This fixture verifies package/index/collection boundaries; full GUI command publication, concurrent manager operations and application-exit fault scenarios remain separate.
Other platform execution, native Intel/minimum macOS, clean systems, full license/source review and formal notarization remain incomplete.
Current production inputs are unchanged from the signed NativeAppearance package; this test-only increment does not create a new package or rerun the unrelated performance benchmark.
